project.title: Metagenomic assessment of bacteria collected from the International Space Station
project.description: Here, we explore how stable the viable ISS microbiome is at ecological and functional levels, by using PMA treatment to track viable microbial taxonomic, functional turnover, and volatility, and quantify AMR and virulence genes at spatiotemporal scales.
